notes.title: FREE UPDATE - VR Mode Now Available!
notes.notes: [p]Today's update introduces VR support into the game for Quest, Index, and VIVE headsets![/p][p][/p][p]Players will be able to access the VR build by opting into the public “vr-beta” branch.[/p][p][/p][p]We are also introducing a public beta branch for testing Quest AR Passthrough, this build of the game is available on the “quest-ar-beta” branch and does not support the VIVE headset.[/p][p][/p][p]Please reach out to [url="https://support@atari.com"]support@atari.com[/url] to report any issues.[/p]
